# Example Solution 1

## **Part 0: libraries**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
RU21 <- read.csv("data/renew-use-2021.csv")
RU22 <- read.csv("data/renew-use-2022.csv")
RU23 <- read.csv("data/renew-use-2023.csv")

TEU21 <- read.csv("data/total-use-2021.csv")
TEU22 <- read.csv("data/total-use-2022.csv")
TEU23 <- read.csv("data/total-use-2023.csv")

EV_by_state <- read.csv("data/ev-registrations-by-state-2023.csv")

AV_by_state <- read.csv("data/av-energy-price-2021-2023.csv")


state_lookup <- tibble(
  abb   = state.abb,
  name  = state.name,
  lower = tolower(state.name)
)

# ---- Harmonize state names ----
harmonize_state <- function(df, col) {
  col <- enquo(col)
  df |>
    mutate(
      .state_raw = str_squish(as.character(!!col)),
      state = case_when(
        .state_raw %in% state_lookup$name ~ .state_raw,
        .state_raw %in% state_lookup$abb  ~ state_lookup$name[match(.state_raw, state_lookup$abb)],
        TRUE ~ .state_raw
      ),
      state = str_to_title(state),
      state_lower = tolower(state)
    ) |>
    select(-.state_raw)
}
```

## **Part 1:** **Defining Research Question**

Chosen Question: How are different cities in different states contributing to the renewable energy share by state?

## **Part 2: Data Preparation and Cleaning**
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

RU21_clean <- RU21 |>
  rename(
    state = state,
    energy_source = energy_source,
    energy_value = energy_value
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = 2021,
    state = str_to_title(state)
  )

RU22_clean <- RU22 |>
  rename(
    state = State,
    energy_source = Energy_Source,
    energy_value = Renewable_Use_2022
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = 2022,
    state = str_to_title(state),
    energy_value = str_remove_all(energy_value, "[$≈~[:alpha:]]"),  # remove symbols and letters
    energy_value = as.numeric(energy_value)
  )

RU23_clean <- RU23 |>
  rename(
    state = State,
    energy_source = Energy_Source,
    energy_value = Renewable_Use_2023
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = 2023,
    state = str_to_title(state),
    energy_value = str_remove_all(energy_value, "[$≈~[:alpha:]]"),
    energy_value = as.numeric(energy_value)
  )

#Combine
renew_clean <- bind_rows(RU21_clean, RU22_clean, RU23_clean)
#   reshape any TEU dataset
clean_total <- function(df, year) {
  df |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Energy_Source,
      names_to = "state",
      values_to = "energy_value"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      year = year,
      energy_source = str_to_title(Energy_Source),
      energy_value = as.numeric(str_remove_all(energy_value, "[^0-9\\.]")),
      state = str_to_title(state)
    ) |>
    select(state, energy_source, energy_value, year)
}

TEU21_clean <- clean_total(TEU21, 2021)
TEU22_clean <- clean_total(TEU22, 2022)
TEU23_clean <- clean_total(TEU23, 2023)

total_clean <- bind_rows(TEU21_clean, TEU22_clean, TEU23_clean)
EV_clean <- EV_by_state |>
  rename(
    state = X,
    energy_value = electric.vehicle.registrations_by_state..2023.
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = 2023,
    energy_source = "EV Registrations",
    state = str_to_title(state),
    energy_value = str_remove_all(energy_value, "[^0-9]"),
    energy_value = as.numeric(energy_value)
  ) |>
  select(state, energy_source, energy_value, year)

```

## **Part 3: Joining / Pivoting Datasets for Analysis**

```{r}


renew_vs_total <- renew_clean |>
  filter(energy_source %in% c("Biomass", "Geothermal", "Hydropower", "Solar Energy", "Wind Energy")) |>
  group_by(state, year) |>
  summarise(renewable_total = sum(energy_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  left_join(
    total_clean |>
      filter(!str_detect(energy_source, regex("renewable", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
      group_by(state, year) |>
      summarise(total_use = sum(energy_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = c("state", "year")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_renewable = round((renewable_total / total_use) * 100, 2)
  )

EV_clean <- EV_by_state[, 1:2] |>
  setNames(c("state", "ev_raw")) |>
  mutate(
    state = str_to_title(str_squish(state)),
    EV_registrations = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(ev_raw), "[^0-9]")),
    year = 2023
  ) |>
  select(state, EV_registrations, year)

energy_ev <- renew_vs_total |>
  left_join(EV_clean, by = c("state", "year")) |>
  mutate(
    EV_ratio = round(100 * EV_registrations / total_use, 4)
  )


AV_clean <- AV_by_state |>
  separate(col = 1, into = c("state", "val_2021", "val_2022", "val_2023"), sep = ",") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("val_"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "energy_value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(str_remove(year, "val_")),
    state = str_to_title(state),
    energy_value = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(energy_value), "[^0-9\\.]"))
  ) |>
  rename(avg_energy_price = energy_value)

full_energy <- energy_ev |>
  left_join(AV_clean, by = c("state", "year"))

```

## **Part 4: Mapping Visualization**

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(full_energy |> filter(year == 2023),
       aes(x = reorder(state, -pct_renewable), y = pct_renewable, fill = pct_renewable)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Renewable Energy Share by State (2023)",
       x = "State", y = "% Renewable Energy") +
  theme_minimal()


```
